answers.label: Benefits and challenges of consequential methods
answers.text: This is the only question we are responding to. Respondents focused feedback on the needs for this methodology to be limited to a the few organizations (eg, policymakers, finance) in order to quantify effectiveness of macro effects of interventions. The Community respondents support focus on attributional rigor in emissions accounting and note confusion by practitioners when they see organizations implement consequential methods in the electric sector (eg, negative subtractions of emissions), and this practice is important to solidify within electricity in order to ensure rigor in other sectors such as transportation and other expansion of robust market-based methodology to Scope 1 and Scope 3. We encourage the AMI TWG to consider the rigor to align Scope 2 methodology with other sectors that will drive long-term, consistent market-based practices that may be included in attributional inventory applications, possible while also not stifling the market.

audit_basis: Own Q18 text reports aggregated member views ('The Community respondents support...'), i.e. a multi-stakeholder membership initiative with a secretariat. Filed as Academia/research.
